Phoenix concerts 2026–27: every big show by venue, with parking and a ride

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: 51 concerts are announced at the Phoenix area’s four big concert venues, as the venues listed them on September 24, 2026, led by the Jonas Brothers on November 27, Trans-Siberian Orchestra on December 6, Hans Zimmer on March 30 and Harry Styles on April 2 and 3, 2027. Below is every show by month and venue, how parking works at each, and a chauffeured ride so the whole group arrives together and nobody drives home.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

What concerts are coming to Phoenix in 2026 and 2027?

As the venues listed them on September 24, 2026, the Phoenix area has 51 concerts on the calendar at its four big concert venues: 16 at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, 16 at Mortgage Matchup Center, 16 at Desert Diamond Arena and 3 at State Farm Stadium, led by the Jonas Brothers on November 27, Trans-Siberian Orchestra on December 6, Hans Zimmer on March 30 and Harry Styles on April 2 and 3, 2027. Chase Field adds the Hondo Rodeo Fest, a rodeo and a concert each night, on November 13 to 15, 2026. Two festivals follow in 2027: Innings Festival at Tempe Beach Park (Feb 26–28, 2027) and M3F at Steele Indian School Park (Mar 5–6, 2027). Venues add shows through the year, so each venue’s own calendar is the final word before you book. The month-by-month list below prints every show from the venue lists our venue pages use, so a date here and a date on the venue page always match.

Which concerts are at the Arizona State Fair in 2026?

Six, in the fair’s Coliseum Concert Series at Veterans Memorial Coliseum in Phoenix, each at 7 p.m.: Gin Blossoms on October 2, Becky G on October 9, All Time Low on October 10, The Offspring on October 16, Russell Dickerson on October 17 and Public Enemy on October 24, 2026. The Coliseum is at 1826 West McDowell Road, on the fairgrounds. Each show is An Evening With the headliner, with no opening act, and every seat is reserved and includes fair admission. The fair itself runs Thursday to Sunday, October 1 to November 1, 2026. Its official lots are the North Lot and the West Lot, which open 2 hours before the admission gates, plus limited reserved VIP parking in the North Lot; the fair says other lots nearby are privately owned. A free Park n’ Ride shuttle runs from Phoenix College, 1202 West Thomas Road, on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, with no shuttles on Thursdays, and its last shuttle back leaves the fairgrounds at 11 p.m. Rideshare drivers enter on 19th Avenue at Encanto and drop off at the southwest corner of the West Lot, and McDowell Road closes between 15th and 19th Avenues after 9 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays. A chauffeured group is dropped where fair staff direct and picked up at one agreed point after the encore. These Coliseum shows are not counted in the four-venue list above.

Which Phoenix concert venue is where?

State Farm Stadium and Desert Diamond Arena face each other across Maryland Avenue in Glendale, in the Westgate Entertainment District off Loop 101. Mortgage Matchup Center, formerly Footprint Center, is in downtown Phoenix at 201 East Jefferson Street. Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is in west Phoenix, at 2121 North 83rd Avenue in Maryvale. Chase Field is downtown too, on the same street as Mortgage Matchup Center, at 401 East Jefferson Street. That matters for the drive: from Old Town Scottsdale, the Glendale venues are about 36 minutes by Google’s typical drive time without event traffic, and downtown Phoenix is closer. Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is not the Talking Stick casino resort in Scottsdale; our venue page explains the difference.

How does parking work at Phoenix concerts?

Every venue sells its own parking and none publishes a limo lane: Desert Diamond Arena’s lots open an hour before doors and take cards only; State Farm Stadium’s lots are cashless and it recommends buying ahead on SeatGeek; Mortgage Matchup Center points to nearby garages bought through ParkWhiz, with a drop-off curb on 3rd Street; Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre has a Gate 3 drop-off. Each venue page has the full parking answer, the drop-off point and the bag policy for that building. A chauffeured group skips all of it: dropped where staff direct, picked up at one agreed point, and nobody drives home.

How do you get home from a Phoenix concert without driving?

Book the ride both ways. By the hour, the vehicle is yours for the night: pickup, dinner, the show and the ride home, with the chauffeur nearby. Our concert pick is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, seating 15. A VIP night takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter; a friend crew the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) ($175 an hour) or the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) ($175); a big group the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28 seats, $250 an hour); and a family the Executive Black Sprinter (14 seats). Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax. Tell the reservations team the show, the pickup address and the rider count at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. Rideshare works too, but after a sold-out show every rideshare guest waits at the same pickup point.

Frequently asked questions

What are the biggest concerts in Phoenix in 2026 and 2027?

Among the announced shows: the Jonas Brothers at Desert Diamond Arena on November 27, 2026, Trans-Siberian Orchestra at Mortgage Matchup Center on December 6, Hans Zimmer there on March 30, 2027, and Harry Styles at State Farm Stadium on April 2 and 3, 2027.

What concerts are at the Arizona State Fair in 2026?

Six Coliseum Concert Series shows at Veterans Memorial Coliseum, all at 7 p.m.: Gin Blossoms (October 2), Becky G (October 9), All Time Low (October 10), The Offspring (October 16), Russell Dickerson (October 17) and Public Enemy (October 24). Every seat is reserved and includes fair admission.

Which concert venues are in Glendale?

State Farm Stadium and Desert Diamond Arena, across Maryland Avenue from each other in the Westgate Entertainment District.

Is Mortgage Matchup Center the same as Footprint Center?

Yes. Mortgage Matchup Center is the new name of the downtown Phoenix arena formerly called Footprint Center, at 201 East Jefferson Street.

Where is Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

At 2121 North 83rd Avenue in the Maryvale area of west Phoenix. It was formerly Ak-Chin Pavilion, and it is not the Talking Stick casino resort in Scottsdale.

How do you get to a Phoenix concert without parking?

Book a chauffeured ride: the group is dropped where venue staff direct, picked up at one agreed point after the show, and nobody drives home. Every venue page lists its drop-off.
